tools.name: list-departments
tools.description: List all departments in the Metropolitan Museum of Art (Met Museum)

tools.name: search-museum-objects
tools.description: Search for objects in the Metropolitan Museum of Art (Met Museum). Will return Total objects found, followed by a paginated list of Object Ids. If the Met Explorer app (open-met-explorer) is open and the user is referring to its existing results, prefer using those results from context instead of calling this tool. The parameter title should be set to true if you want to search for objects by title. The parameter hasImages is false by default, but can be set to true to return only objects with images. Additional optional filters are available for highlights, tags, on-view status, artist/culture match, medium, geographic location, and date range. Use page and pageSize to paginate results.

q.description: The search query, Returns a listing of all Object IDs for objects that contain the search query within the object's data

hasImages.description: Only returns objects that have images

title.description: This should be set to true if you want to search for objects by title

isHighlight.description: Only returns objects designated as highlights

tags.description: Only returns objects that have subject keyword tags

isOnView.description: Only returns objects currently on view

artistOrCulture.description: When true, q is matched against artist or culture

departmentId.description: Returns objects that are in the specified department. The departmentId should come from the 'list-departments' tool.

medium.description: Restricts search to objects with the specified medium

geoLocation.description: Restricts search to objects with the specified geographic location

dateBegin.description: Start year for a date range filter. Must be provided together with dateEnd.

dateEnd.description: End year for a date range filter. Must be provided together with dateBegin.

page.description: 1-based page number for paginated object IDs

pageSize.description: Number of object IDs to return per page (max 100)

tools.name: get-museum-object
tools.description: Get a museum object by its ID, from the Metropolitan Museum of Art Collection. Use this when the user asks for deeper details on a specific object ID.

objectId.description: The positive integer ID of the museum object to retrieve

returnImage.description: Whether to return the image (if available) of the object

tools.name: open-met-explorer
tools.description: Open the interactive Met Explorer app for browsing and filtering objects. For exploration intents, pass q so the app can run a live search on open. After opening, keep your chat handoff short and UI-focused. For deeper details on a specific object ID, prefer get-museum-object.

q.description: Optional initial search query to seed the explorer. If provided, the app automatically executes the search on launch

hasImages.description: Whether the initial search should prioritize objects with images

title.description: Whether the initial query should search only object titles

departmentId.description: Optional department id to pre-select in the explorer
